svg.title: Map of Talas
svg.desc: Schematic plan of Talas: the Old City around the Kokand-era citadel with Shahr-i Kabud and Bazar-i Kalan, the Soviet center and central square, the housing estates, the northern industrial district, the railway entering from the west along the south side of the center to the station, and the western corridor toward Talas Air Base with Communications Square, Nuevo Talas and the Agribusiness Export Zone.
